cells.gaps: No text: public row has been found for Digital Ethiopia 2030; the Ministry of Innovation and Technology gives it a five-year period to 2030 (ETH-025). The only public-text row (ETH-003) is for the predecessor Digital Ethiopia 2025 (period to 2025, ended; superseded 20 December 2025). No domestic finance line is tied to the 2030 strategy (ETH-002 is the predecessor's), and reporting is activity only, so stage 3 needs a public text and stage 4 needs published results.
cells.note: Instrument: Digital Ethiopia 2030, approved by the Council of Ministers on 29 November 2025 (ETH-013) and launched by the Prime Minister on 20 December 2025 (ETH-010), period to 2030. Adopted with no public text held is stage 2.
